newsitem.title: USA: Advanta raised $100 mln via security sale.
newsitem.headline: Advanta raised $100 mln via security sale.

text.p: Advanta Corp said on Tuesday it sold non-convertible capital securities from a newly established Delaware business trust it controlled, raising $100 million of capital.

The 8.99 percent capital securities of the Advanta Capital Trust I were priced at par to yield 235 basis points above the 30- year U.S. Treasury, the company said. Cash distributions would be payable semi-annually beginning June 17, 1997.
They were sold through a private placement and proceeds would be used for general corporate purposes, it said.
